segments.name: XpresSpa®
segments.description: Operates airport spa locations offering travelers premium spa services and related retail products, plus the Treat wellness brand.
segments.evidence: XWELL's subsidiary, XpresSpa Holdings, LLC ("XpresSpa") has been a global airport retailer of spa services through its XpresSpa spa locations, offering travelers premium spa services, including massage, nail and skin care, as well as spa and travel products.

segments.name: XpresTest®
segments.evidence: XpresTest began conducting bio surveillance monitoring with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in collaboration with Concentric by Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc. ("Ginkgo Bioworks") in 2021.

segments.name: Naples Wax Center®
segments.description: Operates upscale off-airport hair removal locations offering waxing services and skincare and cosmetic products.
segments.evidence: operates a group of upscale hair removal locations with core products and service offerings from face and body waxing to a range of skincare and cosmetic products.

revenueModel.text: Travelers pay for spa, waxing and wellness services and retail products at company locations, and government clients pay for bio-surveillance monitoring services.
revenueModel.evidence: XpresTest transitioned from providing COVID-19 testing to supporting public health efforts through bio-surveillance programs at international airports.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company acquired Naples Wax Center, adding a new reportable segment.
changes.evidence: XWELL's subsidiary Naples Wax, LLC, d/b/a Naples Wax Centers ("Naples Wax Center" or "Naples Wax") which was acquired on September 12, 2023, for a purchase price of $1,624, operates a group of upscale hair removal locations with core products and service offerings from face and body waxing to a range of skincare and cosmetic products.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company closed all XpresCheck locations and XpresTest ceased diagnostic testing services.
changes.evidence: As of December 31, 2023, the Company closed all XpresCheck locations and XpresTest no longer provides diagnostic testing services

changes.text: In 2025, the former subsidiary HyperPointe ceased operations.
changes.evidence: XWELL's former subsidiary, gcg Connect, LLC, operating as HyperPointe, provided direct to business marketing support across a number of health and health-related channels and ceased operations during 2025.
